ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Dr. Agarwal's Health Care Limited announced the routine cessation of Mr. Sanjay Anand as an Independent Director, effective September 29, 2026, upon completion of his maximum permissible second term as per SEBI regulations. This compliance-driven departure necessitated the re-constitution of several key Board Committees, including Audit, Nomination & Remuneration, and Risk Management. There are no immediate red flags, as the change is regulatory in nature and not indicative of internal governance issues.
